item.tib: bdud 'dul ge khod gsang ba drag chen gyi mngon rtogs gsal byed 'phrul gyi sgron me
item.coloph: ces pa bsam sbyor rnam par dag pa'i tshul 'di ni/ dad ldan 'ga' yis yang yang yang bskul ngor/ rje chen smra ba'i seng ge shes rab rgyal mtshan gyis/ phyag bzhes nang gi nyer mkho mngon rtogs 'di ni/ phywa btsun drung mu wer zhi bdag gis bsgrigs/ 'gal 'khrul mchis na mgon po gnyan la bshags/ dge rtsa 'gro kun rnams mkhyen thob phyir bsngo/ rjes 'jug nyes pa'i bdud las rab rgyal nas/ zab mo bden par 'phel zhing smin par shog sa sprel zla ba bcu gcig gi yar tshes thun mtshams su/ dben gnas bkra shis sman ri'i khrod du sbyar ba dge legs 'phel//
